blocks.text: This fictional member story explores a small customer discovery exercise. Start with the problem people already face, listen carefully to their current habits, and write down what you learn before proposing a solution. Share your next experiment with the community and invite feedback.

blocks.text: This fictional mentoring article offers a simple starting point: describe your customer, the problem you solve, the resources you need, and one measurable next step. Keep assumptions visible and review them with evidence from real conversations before investing further.
